title: Source change blocks
responsibility: Splits source into named functions/methods and remainder blocks with line bounds, fingerprints and decision counts.

inputs.name: sourceBlocks.code
inputs.description: Original source text to divide into blocks.

inputs.name: sourceBlocks.language
inputs.description: Source family; ts scans script blocks, svelte also emits template and first style remainder, and other families produce one module remainder.

outputs.name: sourceBlocks
outputs.description: Blocks with name, kind, line bounds, 16-character normalized-content hash and complexity. Script fingerprints ignore masked comments and normalize whitespace; named functions start complexity at one, module decisions at zero.
